Archival Dispatch: 15 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Basil Rathbone Word Detective, Babe Ruth, Sports Illustrated, and 93 KHJ Boss Radio

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 4 min
Tags: Basil Rathbone, Word Detective, Babe Ruth, John Havlicek, Bob Gibson, Sports Illustrated, 93 KHJ, Robert W Morgan, Boss Radio, Apollo 11, George Bernard Shaw, The Black Mass, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 82 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 82 recovers and dates 15 historical broadcasts across linguistic detective inquiries, sports legends in their prime, fast-paced Top 40 Boss Radio airchecks, space exploration history, and avant-garde gothic horror: 2 etymological investigations by Basil Rathbone in Basil Rathbone, Word Detective (1946, exploring Tuxedo and Melba Toast), 2 wartime US Navy recruiting dramas hosted by Babe Ruth in The Adventures of Babe Ruth (1944, including his legendary 1932 'Called Shot'), 3 in-depth athlete interviews from Sports Illustrated Interviews (featuring Boston Celtics Hall-of-Famer John 'Hondo' Havlicek and St. Louis Cardinals pitching legend Bob Gibson, 1968), 3 pristine June 1967 Los Angeles airchecks from Robert W. Morgan on 93 KHJ Boss Radio, Lord Dunsany's fantasy horror on The Black Mass (1964), Apollo 11 moon landing transcripts and George Bernard Shaw on Voices of History, and morning comedy on Fun at Breakfast.

1. Basil Rathbone, Word Detective & Babe Ruth (1944–1946)

Cinema icons lending their voices to radio education and wartime morale:
